chunks: And it has indeed been narrated:
"That the tasbih in the Salat of Jaʿfar is after the recitation, and that the order of the tasbih is: Subhan Allah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illa Allah, and Allahu Akbar."

key_terms.التَّسْبِيحَ: the glorifying formulae recited in this prayer
key_terms.جَعْفَرٍ: Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib, after whom this prayer is named

ai.seo_question: What is the order of the tasbih in the Salat of Jaʿfar after recitation?
ai.summary: This narration states that in the Salat of Jaʿfar, the tasbih is performed after the recitation. It also specifies the order of the phrases of dhikr recited in that tasbih.
